full_prompt_en: A square surreal painting shows a tiny solitary figure walking along a pale central avenue toward a narrow illuminated doorway. On both sides of the path rise closely spaced dark red trunks or columns. Their fine red lines spread upward and outward into a huge fan-shaped canopy occupying the middle of the image. The branching mass is symmetrical in feel, yet each filament has a slightly different curve. Behind and around it, curling blue-gray cloud bands form an oval opening, with two dark almond-shaped recesses low on either side that suggest a watchful face without becoming a literal figure. A pale full moon sits at the top center above the clouds. The central doorway glows warm gold, a small destination beneath the towering red structure, and the walker appears as a tiny red mark on the path. Beyond the main forms, the environment fades into a charcoal and slate-blue expanse with a low horizontal ground line and faint repeated vertical marks. The surface looks like meticulously worked tempera or oil with fine dry lines, soft grain, and muted glazing. Brick red and burnt orange concentrate at the center; smoky teal, blue-gray, and near-black surround them, while moonlight and the distant opening supply restrained cream highlights. Illumination feels internal to the doorway and diffuse around the moon, leaving the wide side spaces dim. The repeated upright stems establish a corridor, and the canopy expands their rhythm to an almost architectural scale. A small foreground wedge of pale ground leads the eye straight inward. The whole painting balances precise symmetry with textured organic growth, evoking a solemn, mysterious passage through an impossible landscape.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实绘画描绘一名独行的微小人物沿浅色中央大道走向一扇窄窄的亮门。道路两侧升起紧密排列的深红色树干或立柱。它们的细红线向上、向外展开，形成占据画面中部的巨型扇形顶篷。枝状团块具有近乎对称的感觉，但每根细丝曲度略有不同。在其后方和周围，卷曲的蓝灰云带形成椭圆形开口，两侧低处各有一道深色杏仁形幽处，暗示注视的脸，却并未变成明确人物。一轮浅色满月位于上方中央云层之上。中央门洞发出暖金色光，在高耸红色结构下成为小小的终点；行者则如道路上的一个细小红痕。主要形体以外，环境淡入炭黑和板岩蓝的开阔处，只有低矮水平地线及隐约重复的竖痕。表面如精工蛋彩或油画，具有细密干线、柔软颗粒及低调罩染。砖红与焦橙集中于中心，烟青绿、蓝灰与近黑围绕它们；月光和远处门洞提供克制奶油色亮部。光仿佛从门内自发，又在月亮周围漫开，宽阔两侧则保持昏暗。重复直立枝干构成走廊，顶篷将其节奏扩张到近乎建筑尺度。一块浅色前景楔形地面把目光直接引入。整体在精确对称与有纹理的有机生长之间保持平衡，唤起穿过不可能风景的庄重而神秘的旅程。
style_prompt_en: A dreamlike painted surface uses meticulous fine lines and muted translucent layers to build a monumental central form. Repeated narrow verticals rise into a broad branching fan, enclosed by smoky oval swirls and wide dark side fields. Brick red and burnt orange glow against slate blue, charcoal, and subdued teal. A small warm opening anchors the vanishing point, while a pale circular light hangs above, giving the otherwise dim space a quiet axial balance. Dry, hairline texture remains visible even across large color masses. Perspective narrows sharply toward the center, exaggerating the scale between a tiny low mark and an immense upper shape. The mood is ceremonial, still, and enigmatic, with organic growth organized almost like architecture.
style_prompt_zh: 如梦的绘画表面以精细线条和低调透明色层构筑宏大的中央形体。重复窄竖线升为宽阔分枝扇面，由烟雾般椭圆旋涡和宽大的深色侧域围住。砖红与焦橙在板岩蓝、炭黑及含蓄青绿色前发亮。一个小小暖色开口固定消失点，浅色圆光悬于上方，让昏暗空间形成安静的轴线平衡。即使在大色块上，干燥发丝般的纹理仍可见。透视向中央急剧收窄，放大低处微小标记和巨大上方形体的尺度差。氛围仪式化、静止而神秘，有机生长几乎像建筑一样被组织起来。
theme_en: A tiny figure walks toward an illuminated doorway beneath a vast red branching canopy
theme_zh: 微小身影走向一扇亮门，头顶是巨大的红色枝状顶篷
name: Remedios Varo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
